summary: httptester is a container that hosts resources for integration tests (httpbin, nginx, SSL, SNI, Negotiate auth) so CI doesn't depend on external services.
questions: What is httptester used for in Ansible tests?

answer_card.title: httptester
answer_card.answer_md: A Docker container that serves test resources so CI doesn't rely on external Git or package repos. It provides httpbin, nginx, SSL, SNI and Negotiate authentication. Source: the http-test-container repo.
